title: Flaw on Pro Max
body: No doubt this is a useful app and I’ve always liked the simplicity of it, but now we have a problem. Why is there no way of choosing what to show or hide above the actual calendar sheet in the weekly view (landscape mode)? On Pro Max it has all turned for the worse when a good third or more of the screen is now taken up by other things than the actual week view. The previously rather useful weekly view I was able to enjoy on my old iPhone 8 is mainly causing frustration on my new Pro Max. The Max is still just a phone with limited screen space, meaning massively oversized menu bars aren’t welcome. Can we just get a clear weekly view in landscape mode, please!

title: Appointments tend to disappear
body:
The calendar is from time to time unreliable - appointments are not always stored properly. 

Not possible to set a proper alarm sound either, there is just a "plong", or two if you set two warnings, so one must additionally set an alarm in the Clock app, to get an audible alarm sound.

Which is paradoxically ok, since the appointments tend do disappear from the calendar anyway.

Old appointments also just disappear sometimes, which is unpractical when you for some reason need to review when or how many times you went to the doctor or something.
